description: The authenticated user's rank on the all-time leaderboard for a language and mode.

friendsOnly.description: Restrict the leaderboard to your friends. Requires an ApeKey.

language.description: Language id from Monkeytype, e.g. english, english_1k, spanish, german, french.

mode.description: Typing mode: time, words, quote, custom or zen.

mode2.description: Secondary mode value. time → 15/30/60/120; words → 10/25/50/100; quote → short/medium/long/thorough; zen → zen; custom → custom.

name: get_leaderboard_rank
title: Get your leaderboard rank
